# Metapackink

> Metapackink is a custom packaging manufacturer for premium brands and consumer products.

## Website

- Homepage: https://www.metapackink.com/
- Products: https://www.metapackink.com/products.html
- Packaging solutions: https://www.metapackink.com/packaging-solutions.html
- Contact: https://www.metapackink.com/contact.html

## Company focus

Metapackink develops and manufactures custom packaging for luxury, beauty, fragrance, retail, gifting, jewelry, and other premium consumer products.

## Products

- Premium rigid boxes
- Magnetic closure boxes
- Two-piece rigid boxes
- Perfume and fragrance packaging
- Cosmetic and beauty packaging
- Custom drawer boxes
- Premium gift packaging
- Supporting branded packaging such as paper bags and wrapping paper

## Packaging solutions

Services and capabilities include structural development, material selection, artwork and prototyping, premium finishing, mass production, quality control, inspection, and delivery coordination.

Common materials and finishes include greyboard, specialty paper, fabrics, protective materials, foil stamping, embossing, debossing, spot UV, matte lamination, and soft-touch finishing.
